subject: german
title: Adjectives in Action: Describing Things
welcome_lead: Take core adjectives like gut, groß, klein and use them in real sentences with the verb sein.
meta_desc: GCSE German adjectives: describing size, quality and appearance with sein-based sentences.
final_note: Great work — when an adjective follows 'ist', it stays in its base form. Easy win for writing tasks!

concepts.def: Good — also used to say 'well' (Mir geht es gut).
Big or tall — opposite of klein.
Small or short — common GCSE descriptor.
Beautiful or nice — useful for places and people.
Ugly — opposite of schön; useful contrast adjective.
Old — also 'years old' with Ich bin... Jahre alt.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The verb sein conjugates: ich bin, du bist, er/sie/es ist, wir sind, ihr seid, sie sind.

After ist, the adjective stays in its dictionary form: Das Haus ist groß (the house is big).

Learn opposites in pairs — examiners love contrast:

  • groß / klein — big / small
  • schön / hässlich — beautiful / ugly
  • alt / neu — old / new
  • gut / schlecht — good / bad

Pattern: [Article] + [Noun] + ist + [Adjective].

Examples: Die Stadt ist schön. Der Hund ist klein. Das Buch ist gut.

Add sehr (very) or nicht (not) for variety: Das Auto ist sehr alt.
